questions.question: What does the defer attribute on a <script> element do?
options: Downloads in the background and executes in order after the DOM has finished parsing
Executes the script before any HTML is parsed
questions.hint: Defers execution until the HTML document is fully parsed.
questions.explanation: defer downloads scripts asynchronously while parsing HTML, and executes them in order after the DOM is ready.

questions.question: How does <script async> differ from <script defer>?
options: async preserves execution order, defer does not
async executes immediately as soon as it downloads, potentially interrupting HTML parsing and ignoring order
defer runs before CSS is loaded
questions.explanation: async scripts execute as soon as they finish downloading, without guaranteeing execution order relative to other scripts.

questions.question: Which <link> rel value connects a modern SVG icon to the browser tab?
questions.explanation: <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="..."> links the website favicon.

questions.question: Which resource hint informs the browser to establish early network connections to an external server like Google Fonts?
questions.explanation: rel="preconnect" initiates early DNS lookup and TLS handshakes with an external origin.

questions.question: Where is the most appropriate location for the <title> tag in an HTML document?
questions.explanation: The <title> tag must be nested inside the <head> element.
